title: Shared definitions of the registry files

signals.description: Per-signal source choice, overriding the environment's: signal name to a source name defined in the environment files, or none. A system's choice wins over its pillar's.

role.description: What a system is. It decides the building that stands for it.

messaging.description: Message broker topics and subscriptions. A pillar with neither has no pier, and no boats sail to it.

topics.description: The topics this publishes. A plain entry is a service, whose topic messaging.topicTemplate in town.yaml names (in hub.yaml, a name for messaging.hubTopicTemplate). A block gives a topic its own name, for example { topic: orders.created, service: orders }; leave service out for a topic that belongs to the island as a whole. A topic name is unique in the town.

oneOf.description: A service of this island; the town's template names its topic.

topic.description: The topic's full name, as the broker knows it, for example orders.created.

service.description: The service of this island that publishes it. Leave it out for a topic that belongs to the island as a whole.

subscriptions.description: Topics the pillar's workers consume. Only a worker with a subscription has a queue and a dead-letter queue.

topic.description: The full topic name, for example orders-events. It is the topic's own name, or the one the town's template makes for a topic listed by its service.

consumer.description: The worker in this pillar that reads it.

amber.description: Turns amber at or above this value.

red.description: Turns red at or above this value.

slaP99Ms.description: p99 latency the system should stay under, in milliseconds.

discoverLinks.description: Whether link discovery looks for the calls this system makes (default true). Only an api or a worker makes calls worth finding.

minCalls.description: The fewest calls in a source's window that make the error share and latency worth judging. A system below it is shown as quiet: its rate stays, its error share and latency are left out and it is never amber or red because of them. Default 1.

resources.description: CPU, memory or data store utilisation (0 to 1).

backlog.description: Age of the oldest waiting message, in seconds.
